exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Faithful HD PAINTED GAME diffuse UV texture.

Image1 is the exact ENTIRE native stored RGB edit target 512x256. Image2 is ONLY that identical whole source enlarged4x with nearest pixels, to expose the existing tiny paint pattern. Both are the same single canvas. Output ENTIRE same aspect 512:256 canvas and UV, same orientation, no margin/crop/padding/repacking/rotation/zoom. Original full selected alpha restored numerically after this edit.

Keep ENTIRE mechanical source atlas exactly in place. Upper-right original cream stencil is5005 above021; preserve these exact original four-digit and three-digit shapes, not500S or500$; keep the tiny original decorative paint left of the digits exactly. Source smooth flat brown and slate-blue angular camouflage has soft shading only, NO dots, freckles, mottled chips, grain, rust, speckles or added wear. Mechanical openings, lower thin slots, circles and panels remain same source positions and shapes.

Only improve painted resolution inside the EXISTING shapes. Preserve original palette, matte or shiny material, low contrast and brush softness, relative local lights, all original black gaps/cutouts, and pattern count and scale. Do not redraw little marks into new symbols, add weave/thread/grain/pores/stitches, new folds, bright bevels or hardware. No photograph, new anatomy, new text or new objects. This must remain a faithful old painted game UV texture, no portrait or assembled garment.
